units.objective: Add a --json option to bootstrap-structrr that emits a machine-readable summary containing output_path, entity_count, relationship_count, source_anchor_count, source_subject_count, and source_binding_count while preserving existing human-readable output by default.
acceptance_criteria: --json emits valid JSON on stdout after validation succeeds
The JSON includes output_path and all five evidence counts
Generated snapshots under docs/structrr/current are excluded from later scans
Ephemeral helper files may be created only at declared ephemeral paths and are removed before the durable diff is evaluated
Only paths declared by this execution unit are changed
